correctness.rationale: Ranks of the iid atomless labels can be replaced by uniform priorities. Same-site indicators are incompatible; at distance one integrating x^(a−1)(1−y)^(b−1) on y<x gives the H₁ beta term, and at distance two conditioning on the shared priority z gives (1−z^a)(1−(1−z)^b)/(ab). Closed neighborhoods are disjoint at greater distances. In the forced-forest weighted Cayley sum, each forced edge contributes its two endpoint weights; contracting components gives one sum of weights per component and the remaining global multinomial power. Thus forcing one edge occurs with probability 2/n and gives an endpoint offset distributed by a fair two-way draw plus n−3 global draws; forcing a two-edge path occurs with probability 3/n² and gives a three-way offset (including the middle vertex) plus n−4 draws. The sums count ordered endpoints, and a length-two path has a unique middle, so the prefactors in the claimed finite average follow. The fixed-degree kernels are bounded and their binomial/multinomial inputs converge on the discrete state space to the stated Poisson laws. For the path the respective distance-one kernel values for degrees (1,2),(2,2) are 1/6,7/72, with ordered multiplicities 4,2(n−3); the distance-two values are −1/24,−7/360, with multiplicities 4,2(n−4). Including the diagonal yields (8n−37)/180 even at n=4. Truncating a Poisson input changes its law by the omitted tail mass δ, and the two-input total variation is at most 2δ. The expectation difference bounds sum to at most (1/4+20)δ≤21T₁₀, so the exact truncated certificate gives the advertised strict interval.
residual_risks: This is expectation of a conditional covariance, not the covariance after integrating out the tree and not a statement about concentration or the sign on individual Cayley trees. The strict asymptotic sign need not be read as a claim for every finite n.

value.rationale: A natural paired local-extrema statistic in random tree geometry has contributions of competing signs. The exact average and strictly negative linear coefficient are not dictated by the path or complete-branching benchmarks. The comparison with the positive path sign illustrates that the averaged conditional dependence is sensitive to topology.
residual_risks: The advance is the random-tree average, not a new path formula, not a general geometry criterion, and not an annealed covariance sign.
